emailCommon.buttonFallbackText: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
emailCommon.notificationOptOut: You're receiving this because you enabled email notifications. {manageLink}

welcome.subject: Welcome to Dayopt
welcome.heading: Welcome to Dayopt
welcome.body: Thanks for joining Dayopt. Your account is ready.
welcome.valueProp: Dayopt combines planning, time tracking, and calendar views in one place — so you can see where your time actually goes.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password has been changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password has been changed
passwordChanged.body: Your Dayopt password was successfully changed.
passwordChanged.securityWarning: If you didn't make this change, please reset your password immediately at {resetLink} and contact us at {supportEmail}

mfaDisabled.subject: Multi-factor authentication has been disabled
mfaDisabled.heading: Multi-factor authentication has been disabled
mfaDisabled.body: Multi-factor authentication on your Dayopt account was disabled using a recovery code on {disabledAt}.
mfaDisabled.securityWarning: If you didn't do this, someone may have access to your account. Please reset your password immediately at {resetLink} and contact us at {supportEmail}

accountDeletion.subject: Account deleted
accountDeletion.heading: Account deleted
accountDeletion.body: Your Dayopt account has been successfully deleted as of {deletionDate}.
accountDeletion.dataRemovedIntro: The following data has been permanently removed:
accountDeletion.mistakeLine: If you didn't request this deletion or believe this was a mistake, please contact us immediately at {supportEmail}.
accountDeletion.recreateLine: You're welcome to create a new account at any time at {appLink}.

trialStart.subject: Your 7-day Pro trial has started
trialStart.heading: Your 7-day Pro trial has started
trialStart.body: Your 7-day Pro trial is now active. Here's what you can explore:
trialStart.featureLongRange: Monthly and yearly overviews with past-self comparison
trialStart.noActionNote: No action needed — your trial starts now. If you decide Pro isn't for you, you'll automatically move to the Free plan when the trial ends.

trialExpiring.subject: Your Pro trial ends in 3 days
trialExpiring.heading: Your Pro trial ends in 3 days
trialExpiring.body: Your Pro trial ends on {trialEndDate}. After that, your account will move to the Free plan automatically.
trialExpiring.keepProHint: If you'd like to keep Pro features, you can subscribe anytime from your account settings.
trialExpiring.freePlanNote: No pressure — the Free plan still gives you full access to timeboxing, time tracking, and calendar views.

trialExpired.subject: Your Pro trial has ended
trialExpired.heading: Your Pro trial has ended
trialExpired.body: Your 7-day Pro trial has ended, and your account is now on the Free plan.
trialExpired.freeAccessIntro: You still have full access to:
trialExpired.upgradeHint: If you'd like monthly and yearly overviews, Google Calendar sync, and more, you can upgrade to Pro anytime.

proStart.subject: Welcome to Pro
proStart.heading: Welcome to Pro
proStart.body: Your Pro subscription is now active. Thank you for your support.
proStart.fullAccessIntro: You now have full access to:
proStart.featureLongRange: Monthly and yearly overviews with past-self comparison
proStart.manageHint: Manage your subscription anytime in Settings → Billing.

paymentFailed.subject: Action needed: payment failed
paymentFailed.heading: Action needed: payment failed
paymentFailed.body: We weren't able to process your latest payment for Dayopt Pro.
paymentFailed.urgencyNote: Your Pro features are still active for now, but please update your payment method to avoid any interruption.
paymentFailed.helpLine: If you believe this is an error, or if you need help, contact us at {supportEmail}

paymentRecovered.subject: Payment successful — you're all set
paymentRecovered.heading: Payment successful — you're all set
paymentRecovered.body: Good news — your latest payment for Dayopt Pro has been processed successfully. Your Pro access continues without interruption.
paymentRecovered.noActionNote: No action is needed on your part.

cancellationConfirm.subject: Your Pro subscription has been canceled
cancellationConfirm.heading: Your Pro subscription has been canceled
cancellationConfirm.body: Your Pro subscription has been canceled. You'll continue to have Pro access until {periodEndDate}.
cancellationConfirm.afterPeriodNote: After that, your account will move to the Free plan. Your data will be preserved — nothing is deleted.
cancellationConfirm.resubscribeHint: You can resubscribe anytime from Settings → Billing.
cancellationConfirm.thankYou: Thank you for being a Pro member.
